title: One-time owner-authorized age exception: move source-map-js to 1.2.2 before its seven-day point (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q, B-029) through a single-version, self-expiring rule in the web age gate
objective: Blocker B-029: advisory GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q (high; source-map-js >= 1.0.0, < 1.2.2; first patched 1.2.2) fails web-dependency-security on every new run, so nothing merges. The fixed version 1.2.2 was published 2026-09-30T14:08:09.382Z and reaches 604800 s at 2026-10-07T14:08:09.382Z. No mature supported update removes the package (every postcss 8.x requires source-map-js; every source-map-js older than 7 days is in the vulnerable range). The owner approved ONE early update (D-092 message 84). Deliver one change: the exact pin of source-map-js 1.2.2; a rule in apps/web/scripts/dependency_age_gate.mjs that admits exactly source-map-js@1.2.2 with the registry integrity recorded in D-092 while it is younger than 604800 s, and nothing else; the matching name exclusion in apps/web/.npmrc so the lockfile workflow can resolve it; unit tests of the rule; the policy text brought into line. Every other check stays as it is: host, integrity, audit, npm-CLI advisory, fail-closed behaviour.
business_reason: Owner directive D-092 (2026-10-06, 'Go ahead update it only this 1 time') under CLAUDE.md principle 15 and docs/DEPENDENCY_SECURITY_POLICY.md section 6 (the single owner-authorized, single-package, auto-expiring exception to the AGE requirement; never to an advisory). Ends the merge hold of B-029 about a day early. The orchestrator had recommended waiting; the owner decided.
